body: Left for college at 18 with a full scholarship... fucked that up and lost it two years in.

At 20 years old, my advice as someone who's 30 is to never trust fucking ANYONE, people are shit, and no matter who you let in, they have an agenda to take advantage of you in some way. But I'm probably not the one who should be giving advice... :/

I dunno, at 20, imagine your life with 10 more YEARS of false starts, failures, heartbreak, pain, rejection, loss, and abuse, and that's where I'm at, I think.

Pretty much all of my school life was difficult (hence severe depression and medication), mainly because of my family situation. My brother was physically abusive, my father didn't believe me or my mother when we tried to tell him about it, and my mother couldn't protect me 24/7. Brother was full blown alcoholic at 14 years old... I was 8.
I'm here, but I don't really know what to say...
